lines.english: "Ugh, alright, I'm coming already! Stop ringing the doorbell!"
"Merry Christmas!"
Rushing to stop the racket coming from my doorbell, I open the front door only to be met with an even bigger racket coming from outside.
"…Tone it down, you're being a nuisance to the neighbors. Hurry in already!"
"You're such a buzzkill, man."
"And on Christmas of all days, too…"
"Right?"
"I was having a perfectly good time up until now…
All the packed and half-packed luggage lying around in our apartment makes it already too cramped for two people, let alone five…
…Well, I suppose there won't be any need to use the heater, at least.
"What's that supposed to mean? I called you, didn't I?"
"Yes, you did… Today, a mere hour ago!"
Setsuna and I weren't even home when we were informed that Takeya and the others were about to raid our apartment,
…Though I suppose I'm the only one here who's actually frustrated that this is happening.
The other resident of this apartment is, to put it simply…
"Setsuna! How've you been?"
"Io! It's been so long! Oh, did you cut your hair? It looks just like how it used to back in the day!"
…Predictably ecstatic, to say the least.
"Setsuna!"
"Oh, you're here too, Tomo."
"How rude!"
"Huh, we already meet like once a month, don't we?"
"Today is different. There's this special type of excitement when all your friends gather at once."
Well, I guess the fact that these three can just barge in like that, and the way these two can jab at each other so freely is proof of how close we are.
That doesn't mean I can tolerate this though. Not while we're so damned busy…
"I felt today would be our only chance to drop by, ya know? Tomorrow will be the day before moving day, and yesterday was Christmas Eve…
"Mind your own business. The two of us couldn't even make it home yesterday."
Although I won't confirm nor deny the part about the rabbits.
"Whoa, working in the mass media must be hell. You'd never get that impression by looking at Tomo, though."
"There's plenty of blood and tears hiding behind the gracefulness of a swan… Just so you know, I don't have New Year's off."
"There you have it. You should've just waited until things got less hectic and visited us in our new home."
"And when exactly are things less hectic in your mind?"
"Lemme see… Perhaps six months from now?"
"You just hate my guts, admit it."
We have a go at each other like usual, but this time I manage to pick up on Takeya's clever choice of words.
"Hey, hey! Let's have a hot pot party! I've bought all the ingredients."
"Didn't you say Merry Christmas just earlier?"
"I thought you'd say that, so I made sure the choice of meat was chicken. Merry Christmas!"
"If you're looking for the pot, I've already cleaned it and put it away. It should be somewhere within that mountain of luggage…"
Just earlier, Takeya said "You two were probablyーalsoーgoing at it like rabbits."
"Setsuna, this chicken is done cooking… You'll want some white cabbage and tofu too, right?"
"Thanks, Haruki-kun."
"Oh, these shimeji mushrooms are done as well…"
"Those are the ones I threw in barely a minute ago. Wait about two minutes more. Also, those aren't shimeji mushrooms, they're oyster mushrooms."
"…Good to see you're as insufferable as ever."
"Seriously, every time we come, dinnertime always plays out the same. The head of the house always runs everything."
"I'm amazed you can put up with this every day, Setsuna. Don't you ever lose patience?"
"No, not really. Whenever we do a hot pot at my home, Haruki-kun is practically a godsend. He even takes over for Takahiro."
"Only because Takahiro only ever eats meat if left to his own devices. I have to make sure to mix in some vegetables too."
"So the Ogiso kitchen is under the tyrannical rule of the daughter's husband. What has the Ogiso household come to…"
"Still, hard to believe we're never seeing this apartment again…"
"Looking back, it does feel a bit sad… Actually, on second thought, no."
"The only thing waiting for us here was a lecturing from the owner."
"I spill a single drop of beer and all hell breaks loose."
"Exactly! He'd kick me out just for getting so drunk I'm nearly puking all over. What a terrible homeowner."
"No, if anything, my reaction was only natural. In fact, I was covering for you guys. I was always cleaning up and looking after you."
"Oh, is that what happened? But from what I remember, every time I was preparing to leave, I'd see Takeya collapsed in the hallway…"
"That's exactly what happened, one hundred percent! You never once looked after me no matter how many times I got wasted and crumpled down on the floor!"
"It's your fault for getting wasted every time."
"And he was always suspiciously hiding the fact that he was conscious. Who knows what he'd do to me if I showed him some compassion as he lied there."
"It wasn't my fault! Back then, I…!"
"Hmmm? What about you back then? What are you saying you felt about me back then?"
"Well, um, you know… Ah."
"Hm? What?"
"No, um… My bad, I got too excited there."
"It wouldn't be any fun for you to hear, Setsuna."
The two of them smile at Setsuna with slightly apologetic looks, abruptly bringing the topic that got them so worked up to a close.
"I didn't understand a word of it either. Where's my apology?"
Well, setting Yanagihara aside for now, I understand all too well the meaning behind the silence of these two.
The topic of conversation was, after all, about a time before this place became a home for Setsuna to live in.
A period of my life when I distanced myself from Setsuna… and only allowed a select few people to enter this apartment.
But…
"No, let me hear it."
"Setsuna…"
Setsuna is laughing.
The smile on her face no longer bears the sense of sadness and loneliness that I saw back then,
"I mean, I don't like how you guys know things about Haruki-kun that I don't."
"Setsuna…"
Because we've decided.
…That we'll no longer look to the past in search of our mistakes anymore.
Instead of lamenting the sorrows of the past, we've promised each other to put all our efforts into being happy in the present and the future.
That's what we promised each other.
"Besides, there might be a hint or two in those stories that will help me find Haruki-kun's weaknesses."
"Setsuna?"
"Scary!"
"You're acting like an adult, Setsuna. …Though not in a good way, I'd say."
We promised, right…?
"Come on, lemme hear all about Haruki-kun back then. His personality must've been awful. Did he have any lame hero's journey stories?"
"N-No… that's…"
"Hey, who cares about obscure stuff like his past? Listen to what I have to say instead!"
"The only one who enjoys listening to you speak is yourself!"
"Oh, don't be like that! I'll tell you all about the behind-the-curtains juiciness of East Asia TV."
"…That does indeed sound very juicy, but should you really be telling people about that?"
"So, I don't want to poke my nose in or anything, but how are you two getting along nowadays?"
With the hot pot, rice porridge, beer, and many other kinds of alcohol cleaned up, we reached the present.
As time went by, we found ourselves divided into groups, with Takeya and me out here, and the girls inside.
"Well, about that… We're in a really heated cold war right now."
"A cold war is by definition cold, not heated!"
And before we knew it, the topic of conversation shifted to these two rather than us.
The two who share a bond that dates further back than us, all the way back to middle school.
"How would that happen in the first place? I thought you were just seconds away from popping the question…"
"I am, no doubt about it."
"Did you meet her parents?"
"What's there to meet? I've pretty much known them since middle school, including her grandparents."
"Is that where things went wrong? Did her dad say 'like hell I'll hand my daughter over to a flashy-looking piece of garbage like you'
"They thanked me with tears in their eyes. Don't underestimate my social skills."
"What is it, then? Don't tell me you cheated on her…"
"I don't do that stuff anymore. Also, you're the last person I wanna hear that from."
"H-Huh? I don't get it."
"Like I said… we're fighting over who gets parental leave once our baby is born."
"…Even so, aren't you two jumping the gun a little?"
"Exactly. Worry about that after you tie the knot."
"No, no, don't you think that's something really important? You see, my job's finally starting to get interesting now that I'm in my third year."
"I bet you got a promotion to a supervisory role, and now you enjoy toying with those under you."
"W-Well, Io does have good leadership skills, in a way."
"No, I didn't get promoted. But anyway, setting maternity leave aside, I want to return to my job as soon as possible."
"Oh…"
"So I thought about splitting the parental leave 50/50 with Takeya, and that's the greatest compromise I can make in this matter."
"Compromise? Is that really a compromise?"
"Sounds tricky… Looks like Takeya is working pretty hard as well."
"That's true… I hate to admit it, but he's above me both in terms of salary and success."
"Then just avoid having a baby for a while."
"…Not happening."
"Yup, we want our kids early. If there's one thing we can agree on, it's that."
"…I see."
"You two don't seem like the type that would want something like that."
"You think so? Well, maybe you're right."
"I mean, I'd feel bad for the baby if you two were to split."
"No, that won't ever happen… If our relationship could ever be broken apart, it wouldn't have taken us ten years to reach this point."
"Io…"
"If you're so confident, you should've started dating from the start."
"…You won't regret it?"
"What are you on about? Of course I won't!"
"No, I meant how you just told me about all the escapades of your youth… If I were you, I'd be burying my head in embarrassment."
"…You can bet your ass I'll regret that. I'll no doubt send you a text tomorrow, begging you to forget all about it."
"Haha, haha…"
The feelings of people are all very similar.
Even so, there are subtle differences that separate one individual's feelings from another's, and it's these differences that make them so precious.
Time will inevitably cause our own affairs and the affairs of others around us to converge.
For better or worse, we will forever tuck them into our memories, and for better or worse, they will lead us to the path for our futures.
"Another toast, then."
"Sure."
"To the two of you."
"To the two of you."
"Ah… What about Yanagihara?"
"Who cares about her? She always finds a way to make herself happy without our blessings."
"…Well, I can't deny that."
"Yup… Cheers."
Popping open another pair of beer cans, we make a toast to the unknown future ahead.
